name: 05 Obsidian Mirror Float Pool
purpose: The reveal of B1: out of a 3 m corridor into a 13.5 m dome where a perfectly still, black, salt-dense pool reflects a glowworm ceiling, so floating guests seem to hang in a starfield; people whisper and slow down.

ceiling_profile.note: Smooth-ish basalt dome (7 m at the wall springing, 13.5 m crown) carrying the glowworm field; dark and unlit except the worms so the reflection is clean.

spurs.note: Rim walk continues round the south half (SE pavilion, lounge benches): a loop.

hero.why: The starfield is the reason the room exists: a cyan glowworm dome over a dead-still black salt pool that doubles it, so floaters hang in stars. It is the brightest surface; the pool is its mirror (water built by the graybox from layout w_mirror), and everything warm is kept low and at the edge.

water.note: Matches layout w_mirror (r 12, z -20.05, rim -20.00). Planar reflection; no underwater lights, no ripples except at the steps.

sightlines.see: Straight across the black pool to the east arch; glowworm stars above and below; the glacier's blue far beyond the arch.
Arriving from the east: NW pavilion glowing across the pool, the cor_mirror arch to its left.
Down into the pool: the dome reflected, floaters among the stars.

concept.match: Low across the black pool toward the east arch: NW pavilion close on the left, SE pavilion and pale niwaki on the right, a line of small lanterns along the far rim doubled in the water, glowworm dome reflected so the floaters hang in stars, a band of mist on the left rim.

dressing.why: Rock at the dome's foot only; the deck middle stays open.

mood.key: starfield in a black pool (teal glowworms, doubled)
mood.palette: teal glowworm points, black obsidian water, small amber lanterns and shoji glow kept low
mood.mist: A thin band on the west and north rims only; the pool centre is clear so the reflection is clean.

waivers.reason: The hero is a reflective black surface; its brightness is the reflected glowworm field over a large area. Individual lantern points may out-measure it per pixel, so lanterns here are 'low' intensity and the bake should be judged on area luminance.

lighting_request: glowworm_ceiling should render as cyan point emission (9000 K) and w_mirror as black mirror water; today only heroes glow and water is teal.
light_notes: Pavilion shoji glow comes from pavilion_engawa's own light; glowworm_ceiling emission is the hero's light. Keep lanterns 'low'.
conventions: anchored/hero 'at' = object centre on its floor; facing_deg = bearing of the asset's front (+Y). Extra keys beyond SCHEMA.md: spurs, segments, implied portals, bed_z/top_z, stagger/groups on lights, footprint on still water.
